input.quote: If the Management Committee nevertheless reclaims any capacity in the APCN 2 assigned to such defaulting Party, the defaulting Party shall not be entitled to any payment or credit for the reclaimed capacity.
input.rationale: Subparagraph 23.2 imposes a breach-triggered forfeiture on us: on a payment default of as little as three months (23.1), the Management Committee may reclaim our entire allocated capacity, we receive no payment or credit for it, and we forfeit every amount already paid under the Agreement, while remaining liable for accrued unpaid accounts. That is a penalty running against Customer, wholly unrelated to the actual loss and capable of far exceeding the remaining contract value, so it fails the fallback and sits in walk-away territory. There is no liquidated-damages or early-termination-fee clause elsewhere in the Agreement, and no service credits run to us, so the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties) is the right target: we delete the no-credit denial and the forfeiture of amounts paid, leaving reclamation and accrued-account liability intact. The exit timing and the denial of capital-cost credit on voluntary withdrawal (Subparagraph 18.1 / "No credit for capital costs will be made to a Party that terminates its participation") are exit economics addressed under the termination rules and are not re-flagged here; default interest under 7.8 is a financing charge, not a penalty.

mappings.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.

proposal.summary: Remove the penalty forfeiture on payment default in Subparagraph 23.2
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We accept reclamation of capacity for genuine payment default, but our playbook does not permit liquidated damages or penalties payable by us, so we have removed the forfeiture of amounts already paid and the denial of any credit for reclaimed capacity. Liability for accrued unpaid accounts is untouched.

ops.oldText: If the Management Committee nevertheless reclaims any capacity in the APCN 2 assigned to such defaulting Party, the defaulting Party shall not be entitled to any payment or credit for the reclaimed capacity.
ops.newText: If the Management Committee nevertheless reclaims any capacity in the APCN 2 assigned to such defaulting Party, the defaulting Party shall not be liable for any liquidated damages or penalty in respect of the reclaimed capacity.

ops.oldText: The defaulting Party is not entitled to any reimbursement of any amounts it had paid under this Agreement.
ops.newText: Amounts already paid by the defaulting Party under this Agreement shall not be forfeited.
